text: すこし　あそんでって　やるぜ！

structure.jp: あそんでって　やるぜ！
structure.en: I'll stick around and play with you!

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb means doing it and then going on your way. あそんでって is the quick spoken form of あそんでいって = 'play a while before moving on'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: あそんでって　やるぜ
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing something for someone you look down on, like a favour from above. あそんでって やる = 'I'll do you the favour of playing with you'.
